findings.title: Card comments cite 12 private members the card no longer has (17 mentions)
findings.claim: Comments in www/heatpump-optimizer-card.js name 12 distinct `_name` members (17 mentions) that resolve to nothing in the loaded card, its code, or the backend code; 7 were renamed to module functions without the underscore, 5 have no successor.
findings.mechanism: The card's private methods were moved out of the element classes into module-level functions (`_lineLabel` -> `lineLabel`, `_resolveEntity` -> `resolveEntity`, `_fieldPoints`, `_extraFields`, `_seriesUnit`, `_laneGroupInner`, `_onSlotEdit`) or refactored into collaborator classes (`_refreshLayout`, `_applyView`, `_restoreSlotFocus`, `_onWhatIfInput`, `_runWhatIf`); the prose that routes a reader through them kept the old names, so a reader grepping for the named method finds only the comment.

findings.title: Three comments cite a number the code beside them does not deliver
findings.claim: Three production comments state a number that the value measured from the production symbol contradicts: the defrost derate floor is described as 'less than half' but clamps at 0.55; the valve-write epsilon comment says the write recurs 'every 15 minutes' but the default cycle is 30; the plan-stale floor comment reasons about a '5-minute update interval' the config flow's minimum of 10 never admits.
findings.mechanism: Each comment carries a literal restatement of a value owned elsewhere (DERATE_MIN, DEFAULT_OPTIMIZATION_INTERVAL, the optimization-interval selector minimum); the value moved or never matched, and nothing ties the prose to the symbol.

findings.title: DHW_COLD_WATER_TEMP comment claims the draw model heats from it; the draw reads the configured inlet
findings.claim: const.py:337-339 says DHW_COLD_WATER_TEMP is 'the mains temperature the DHW draw model already assumes (thermal_model's dhw_draw_power heats from ~10 C) -- named so the coil math and the draw model cannot quietly disagree', but dhw_draw_power heats from ThermalParameters.dhw_inlet_reference, which differs from the constant at 46 of the 47 inlet settings the config flow offers.
findings.mechanism: The v4.0.0 T3 inlet model (configured annual mean, seasonal swing, live sensor) replaced the constant in the draw; thermal_model.dhw_coil_draw_reduction's own docstring (thermal_model.py:1291-1297) records that using the constant beside the new draw misallocated heat. The const.py comment still describes the pre-T3 coupling, and the constant now survives only as a default argument.

evidence.unit: of 47 inlet settings where the draw's cold end != DHW_COLD_WATER_TEMP
